question: To whom is obeisance offered in this mantra of salutation?
premises: The addressed one has the form of Vāmadeva
The addressed one is lord of dreams
Obeisance is offered to that lord
inference: Reverence is directed to Vāmadeva as the lord governing dreams
plain_english: Obeisance to him whose form is Vāmadeva, the lord of dreams.
